name: Hero Domain
body:
Granted Powers: In campaigns that use the optional hero point system, you gain Hero’s Fortune as a bonus feat. Otherwise, you gain Auspicious Birth as a bonus feat, even if you did not select the hero domain at 1st level.

Protagonist’s Halo (Su)

As a swift action, you can give yourself a +1 bonus on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls (including unarmed and natural attacks), and combat maneuver checks. This bonus lasts for 1 round.

This untyped bonus increases by an additional +1 for every 5 cleric levels you possess. A use of this ability does not stack with another use of this ability (such as via using the burst of heroic spirit domain power below). You can use this ability for a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Burst of Heroic Spirit (Su)

At 8th level, you can reach deep and tap into your inner reserves to burn with your heroic spirit to eke out a bit more effort. As a move action action, you can gain the effects of borrowed time (including the drawbacks). Unlike the borrowed time spell, this ability is not a temporal or transmutation effect; instead, it is treated as an evocation effect. This ability lasts for a number of rounds equal to your cleric level. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

Domain spells: 1st–divine favor; 2nd-bull’s strength; 3rd–protection from energy; 4th–divine power; 5th–righteous might; 6th–stoneskin; 7th–dance of a thousand cuts; 8th–divine vessel; 9th–shapechange.
